target_customer: API and tool vendors that pay for private benchmarking and analytics, and teams and AI agents that use the free public benchmarks to choose vendors
problem: Teams and agents picking among APIs, vendors and tools lack independent, current comparisons. Openbenchmarks runs open benchmarks (search, document processing, enrichment, inference, voice) refreshed hourly, and sells private benchmarking so vendors can see where they lose to competitors.
business_model: Free public benchmarks as distribution (CC-BY-4.0 data, API) with paid private benchmarking and analytics for vendors
product_category: Independent benchmarking and vendor evaluation for AI agent tooling

founders.name: Fenil Suchak
previous_startups: OpenFunnel (GTM search and agents for sales, YC F24)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built cloud-scale vector databases at Oracle and was a dorm mate of Aditya at BITS Pilani; the YC page does not list a degree.

founders.name: Aditya Lahiri
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the YC directory entry; the YC page text says Aditya built AI agents at scale at Appfolio in the OpenFunnel section.

technical_complexity.rationale: Running and refreshing benchmarks across many vendor APIs is engineering and ops work; the hard part is methodology credibility and cost of running tests, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Historical benchmark data and perceived independence can compound, but the method is open (public methodology, CC-BY data) and well funded players like Artificial Analysis do similar work for models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source found. Artificial Analysis benchmarks model and provider endpoints; no acquisition of Openbenchmarks found.

market_need_then: AI agents and teams were choosing among fast-multiplying APIs in 2024 with little neutral comparison data. No company specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses openbenchmarks.com; acquisition date not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Neutral and data-first; publishes methodology and refresh cadence.

branding.brand_signature: Public hourly benchmark leaderboards with open licensing.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage found; the name is descriptive and shared by Snorkel's unrelated 'Open Benchmarks Grants' program, which crowds search.

pivots.from: OpenFunnel: GTM search and agents for sales teams
pivots.to: Openbenchmarks: independent benchmarks and helping customers sell to AI agents
pivots.why: Not stated in any source. The YC page lists OpenFunnel as the founder's previous company, but OpenFunnel is also a separate YC F24 listing, so whether this is a pivot or a second venture is unclear.

outcome_analysis: Openbenchmarks is an active four person San Francisco company from YC Fall 2024 run by founders who previously built OpenFunnel. It publishes free hourly benchmarks across search, document processing, enrichment, inference and voice, and sells private analytics. No verified funding, revenue or exit was found. Outcome is undetermined; the main questions are whether vendors will pay and whether the benchmarks are seen as independent.
